nodes.label: AutoML Platform
nodes.details: SQS-driven platform serving 27 production models, with MLflow- and S3-tracked training and automated champion-challenger deployment gated on F1 and recall.

nodes.label: Confidence-Gated Correction
nodes.details: ML system with dual confidence thresholds under a ≥98% recall constraint, routing low-confidence predictions to Gemini for automated label correction, retraining, and human-free review.

nodes.label: FAISS-Backed RAG Pipeline
nodes.details: Retrieval pipeline built with LlamaIndex, HNSW, and Sentence Transformers, using GPU/CPU routing and BGE reranking for tender processing.

nodes.label: Document Extraction Service
nodes.details: Production document extraction service using Gemini with token-aware routing across PDF, DOCX, DOC, XLS, XLSX, and RTF.

nodes.label: MLOps Triage Agent
nodes.details: Autonomous incident-response agent built with Qwen3-30B, vLLM, and 18 MCP tools for production root-cause analysis and gated, automated PR generation.

nodes.label: LLM Cost Governance & Eval
nodes.details: Automated LLM evaluation framework plus Redis-backed cost governance and monitoring dashboards tracking spend, accuracy, and prediction volume.

nodes.label: ML Classification Services
nodes.details: Productionised classification services for tender auto-labelling, sector tagging, contract classification, and news relevance, with FastAPI, GPU/CPU routing, and Gemini fallback.

nodes.label: Redis Cache Rollover
nodes.details: Cache rollover mechanism that cut Redis memory usage across production services.

nodes.label: BidAssist Crawler & Parsing
nodes.details: Microservices and large-scale Selenium scraping pipelines for BidAssist eTender data ingestion, plus OCR- and CSV-based document parsing integrated with AI data extraction.

nodes.label: AI SOC & DevOps Orchestrator
nodes.details: Multi-agent system unifying Security Operations and DevOps health monitoring via an event-driven and polling hybrid architecture, with a Global Orchestrator dispatching to specialized agent swarms for threat detection, self-healing infrastructure, confidence-gated remediation, threat intel enrichment, and proactive patrol scheduling.
